lead: Mahatma Gandhi was an Indian politician, born on 2 October 1869 in Porbandar.
He died on 30 January 1948 in Gandhi Smriti at the age of 78.
He is associated with work such as satyagraha and has been recognised with Time Person of the Year and Order of the Companions of O. R. Tambo.
The sections that follow break down Mahatma Gandhi's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Mahatma Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mahatma Gandhi was born on 2 October 1869 in Porbandar, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name મોહનદાસ ગાંધી at birth and is publicly known as Mahatma Gandhi.

Public records name his father, Karamchand Uttamchand Gandhi and his mother, Putlibai Karamchand Gandhi. He is a sibling of Raliatbehn Gandhi, Muliben Gandhi, Pankunvarben Gandhi, Laxmidas Karamchand Gandhi and Karsandas Gandhi.
He studied at Mahatma Gandhi Museum, Inner Temple, University College London and Samaldas Arts College.
He is recorded as speaking Gujarati.

sections.heading: Mahatma Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Mahatma Gandhi works primarily as a politician, barrister, political writer, journalist, philosopher and autobiographer.
Among the credits most often linked to Mahatma are satyagraha.
